title: Nusaro - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Nusaro in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Nusaro is a dark-element weapon used by Monoco. It scales with Defense (A), Agility (A).

sections.title: How to Get the Nusaro
sections.content:
Location: Crimson Forest - Paint Cage.

Obtained from Crimson Forest - Paint Cage.

sections.title: Is the Nusaro Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (A), Agility (A). A dedicated dark pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
